# `aitbc coin-requests list`

List coin transfer requests with optional status and sender filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc coin-requests list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--status` | text | — | no | Filter by status (pending, approved, rejected, expired) |
| `--sender` | text | — | no | Filter by sender |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc coin-requests list
```
